about: The quarters of a generated town (the owner, 6 November: a town of recognizable, navigable organization, not a directory): each a part of the town a player can learn, walked to by its heart, holding the places whose role it lists. A town of more than a few places is given those of its quarters it has a place for (a town with no waterside has no waterside quarter); a place of another module in the town (a going-on's ground, a scenario's yard) is in the quarter its role names here, else in that of the place it opens off, else with the green. Each place keeps its containment in the town; a quarter is only where it lies. An adventure that adds a place to a town says its quarter with inQuarter (data/rules/core.kyr). A quarter is come into at an open place of its own (a square, a street, a bank), its heart where that is open, else the first of its places a way goes to that is not a door; a quarter with no open place is no quarter apart, and its places are the green's (the owner's play of 7 November: "the market" was come into by a shop's door). The green is called as the town calls its heart ("{heart}", the market-place). Add a role to a quarter here, or a quarter: nothing in the engine needs to change.
